structure: The central pawns remain flexible. Avoid fixing the structure until you know which file, diagonal, or outpost your pieces need.
plan: Challenge White's center before it becomes stable, finish development, castle, and use the freeing pawn break associated with the Semi-Slav Defense.
whyLearn: Semi-Slav Defense: Gunderam Gambit is identified by the canonical ECO D31 position. Learning it from move one teaches both the route into the position and the strategic questions that remain after the named opening has been reached.
mistakes: Treating the name Semi-Slav Defense: Gunderam Gambit as proof that the same plan works after every opponent reply.
Continuing the sample line after a forcing capture, check, or central break changed the position.
Starting wing play before development and king safety are adequate for the center to open.
